top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a quantitative, falsifiable 2011 prediction of flat bands at a magic angle, tested by the 2018 discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states and since reproduced by independent groups. Interaction strength became a tunable control parameter, and the citation can avoid the open pairing mechanism. The remaining weaknesses are the single experimental name and the earlier twisted-graphene band-structure work, both manageable in the citation wording. P002 (optical lattice clocks) is clean, mature and uncontested, so it is a sound second choice. No award is last because both proposals are mature and well allocated.
